  ✓ ob1-distribute.sh must complete the binary and database publish path despite transient scp connection resets, with bounded transport-only retry, truthful non-transport failures, and a regression self-test; all repository gates pass.: Independently reproduced all four sub-requirements. (1) TRANSIENT RESET RECOVERY: scripts/publish-catalog.sh stage_artifacts() ships binary (off-by-one.new) + DB snapshot (off-by-one.db.new) as one idempotent unit; my own PATH-shim test (scp fails 1st call with 'scp: Connection closed' rc 255, then succeeds) gave FINAL_RC=0, scp_calls=3, ssh_calls=2, output 'staged pair -> ...', 'activated on ...', 'public catalog healthy on ... (HTTP 200)'. (2) BOUNDED TRANSPORT-ONLY RETRY: scripts/lib/transport-retry.sh retry_transport() retries only TRANSPORT_RESET, bounded by TRANSPORT_RETRIES (default 3 => 4 attempts), doubling 2->8s backoff, returns LAST rc; persistent reset test gave FINAL_RC=2, scp_calls=4, ssh_calls=0, verdict 'TRANSPORT_RESET after 3 retry attempt(s) (4 total, budget 3)'. (3) TRUTHFUL NON-TRANSPORT FAILURES: scp rc 1 'No space left on device' => FINAL_RC=1, scp_calls=1 (exactly one attempt), ssh_calls=0, verdict 'NON_TRANSPORT (no retry) ... attempt 1 of 4', 'artifacts on the host were NOT replaced (activation skipped)'; scp rc 255 'Permission denied (publickey,password)' => FINAL_RC=3, scp_calls=1, verdict 'TRANSPORT_PERMANENT (no retry)' + operator recipe; direct transport_classify() test confirmed rc0->OK, 255+closed->TRANSPORT_RESET, 255+Permission denied->TRANSPORT_PERMANENT, rc1->NON_TRANSPORT, rc6->NON_TRANSPORT. Staged-pair guard: remote activation body refuses unless BOTH staged files exist and are non-empty (exit 6); activation attempted exactly once, never retried. (4) REGRESSION SELF-TEST: bash scripts/tests/transport-retry-selftest.sh => 'transport-retry self-test: 108/108 checks passed — ALL GREEN' (17 arms incl. NEUTER negative control proving retry is conditional, staged-pair guard, static mode, config errors); wired into Makefile (make transport-retry-selftest) and .github/workflows/ci.yml job 'transport-retry-selftest'. (5) REPOSITORY GATES (run fresh): gofmt -l cmd/ internal/ pkg/ sql/ => empty (exit 0); go build ./... => exit 0; go vet ./... => exit 0; go test ./... -short -p 1 -count=1 -timeout 120s => 13 pkgs ok, 0 FAIL; gitreins guard --full => 'Tier 1 Guards: PASS' (secrets clean, go_build ok, go_lint ok, go_tests). Note: gitreins' go_tests step logged 'No Go files staged' (vacuous for this shell-only change set), so I independently ran the full Go suite above — it passed. Deployed copy ~/.hermes/scripts/ob1-distribute.sh is byte-identical to tracked scripts/ob1-distribute.sh (diff empty); docs/publish-transport.md (8429 bytes) documents exit codes 1-6, classification table and operator knobs; README.md lines 384-448 reference all new scripts and the doc.
